title: Metrica — Parametric Type Foundry
description: Design a typeface with sliders, then download a real .ttf the browser has already accepted.
concept: Every glyph is a skeleton — lines, arcs and splines in a unit box — and fourteen parameters decide how a pen strokes it: weight, contrast, slant, serif slabs, terminals, stencil cuts, overshoot and spacing. Move a slider and all 82 outlines are rebuilt in about 20 ms, then assembled byte by byte into a TrueType binary (glyf, loca, cmap, hmtx, head, hhea, maxp, name, OS/2, post) with no library and no network. The Specimen tab renders with that compiled font through the FontFace API, so what you read is the file itself, not a canvas imitation — and the same file downloads as a .ttf you can install.
features: 14 live parameters across proportions, weight/contrast, style and spacing
8 presets (Grotesk, Slab, Didone, Mono, Rounded, Stencil, Italic, Poster) plus Randomise
Glyph inspector: tap any of 50 glyphs for skeleton, outline points, sidebearings and metrics
Specimen tab renders live through the FontFace API using the compiled binary
Export a real installable .ttf, an SVG specimen sheet, and a parameters .json
Save designs to localStorage and share a design as a URL hash

interaction.mouse: Drag the parameter sliders to reshape every glyph at once; hover the tabs to move between Design, Glyphs, Specimen and Export
interaction.click: Pick a preset, tap a glyph in the grid to inspect it, toggle skeletons/points/guides, or hit a download button
interaction.touch: Full touch layout — the panel stacks under the stage, glyph cells are tap targets, sliders are thumb-sized
interaction.keyboard: 1–4 switch tabs · ← → step through glyphs in the inspector · E downloads the .ttf · R randomises
